name: Send a coffee newsletter at 09:00 local time in every region

parameters.name: Morning coffee newsletter
parameters.input: Send the morning coffee newsletter every day at 9am local time in Paris, New York, Tokyo, and Perth

parameters.content:
## Setup before publishing

1. Install `@rrulenet/n8n-nodes-rrulenet`.
2. Add rrule.net and Brevo credentials.
3. Edit the sender and four recipients in **Configure regional audiences**.
4. Run the manual Paris preview.
5. Publish the workflow only after the preview succeeds.

## Why rrule.net?

This is one logical schedule with four targets. Paris and New York keep 09:00 wall-clock time through DST changes; Tokyo and Perth remain on their non-DST offsets. Route each execution with `target_id` and verify `target_timezone`.

## Replaceable content

The RSS feed and five-article limit are configured in **Configure regional audiences**. The HTML builder escapes feed text and only links to HTTP(S) URLs. Brevo sends one transactional digest per target; adapt consent and unsubscribe handling before using it as a public marketing newsletter.
